name: Toeloop
notes: Easiest jump; most common second jump in a combination because it takes off from the landing edge

name: Salchow
notes: Edge jump; usually entered from a back inside three turn

name: Loop
notes: Takes off and lands on the same foot and same edge with no assistance; the other legal second jump in a combination

name: Flip
notes: Edge-callable: an unclear or wrong edge draws ! or e

name: Lutz
notes: Counter-rotated - the entry curve runs opposite to the rotation direction

name: Axel
notes: The only forward takeoff; carries an extra half revolution so a triple axel is 3.5 rotations
